description: Pitch-synchronous time-SHRINK by deletion: keeps 1 chunk in every 'propkeep' chunks of segcnt FOF grains and discards the rest, compressing the sound to 1/propkeep of its length with pitch and vowels untouched - the inverse of psow dupl. Duration model indur / propkeep verified to +0.8% worst (propkeep 2 -> 1.0024 from 2.0; 4 -> 0.5040; 6 -> 0.3403 vs 0.3333 +2.1%; 2 on 3 s -> 1.5069). MODE-KEYWORD BANNER BUG (first-class): the usage line reads 'psow del ...' but the binary only accepts 'delete' - invoking 'psow del' fails with exit 255 and an EMPTY error message. propkeep is breakpoint-capable as a positional brk file (verified: a 2->6 ramp renders 0.5676 s, differing from both the /2 (1.0024) and /6 (0.3403) scalar renders); segcnt refuses breakpoints. CDP-enforced: propkeep 2-20 (afta8's 0-1000 is wrong), segcnt 1-256. MONO only; deterministic; same trust-the-pitch-file landmine as the rest of the psow family.
musical_use: Time-compression that never chipmunks: straining the voice through a mesh (manual's image) whose spacing is propkeep and whose hole size is segcnt. Small segcnt (1-3) with low propkeep (2-3) halves or thirds a phrase almost transparently; large segcnt keeps big intact lumps and the deletion becomes an audible telegraphic chopping - five distinct 'meshes' are worth auditioning per the manual (high/low proportion x big/small chunks). Since consecutive periods are near-identical in sustained vowels, deletion there is nearly lossless; in consonant regions it eats articulation first - keep propkeep low on consonant-dense text. Breakpoint propkeep to compress the boring middle of a phrase harder than its ends. Same pitch-trace workflow as psow stretch/dupl.

pitchdata.description: Auxiliary text breakpoint file of time/frequency pairs for the source's pitch (write_data_file(); any extension except .brk). Frequency zeros allowed (no-signal); needs some real frequency content; bad content refuses 'No data in brkpnt file'. The FOF cutting trusts this file (family landmine).

propkeep.description: Keep 1 chunk in every propkeep (CDP-enforced 'Parameter[2] Value (1.000000) out of range (2.000000 to 20.000000)' - identity 1 refused, 1000 refused; afta8's 0-1000 advisory is wrong). Breakpoint-CAPABLE as a positional brk file (verified: 2->6 ramp renders 0.5676 s, differing from both scalar-endpoint renders).

segcnt.description: FOF grains per chunk - the deletion granularity (CDP-enforced 'Parameter[3] Value (300.000000) out of range (1.000000 to 256.000000)'). Small = transparent thinning, large = audible chopping. Breakpoint refused (family-standard).

examples.expected_use: Output ~indur / 2, pitch and vowel intact (trace.txt via write_data_file()).

examples.description: Telegraphic chop: keep 1 big chunk in 6.
examples.expected_use: Output ~indur / 6 in audible lumps - the coarse-mesh effect.

known_issues: BANNER BUG (first-class): the binary's own usage line says 'psow del' but only the mode word 'delete' is accepted; 'psow del' exits 255 with an empty error. The entry pins the working keyword.
propkeep = 1 (keep everything) is refused - range floor 2; there is no no-op setting.

Duration honesty: indur / propkeep held to +0.8% at propkeep 2-4; +2.1% at propkeep 6 on a 2 s file (chunk quantisation: the kept-chunk count rounds up). Plan with slack at high propkeep on short files.
GARBAGE-THROUGH LANDMINE (psow-wide): no pitched-material check - suitability and trace truthfulness are the caller's job.
Deletion eats consonants before vowels (consecutive vowel periods are redundant; consonant regions are not) - keep propkeep low on speech, or breakpoint it around the articulation.
MONO only ('must be mono', psow-wide). Deterministic (runs 1.2 s apart byte-identical).
